### He Wears Your Picture Badge
Author: Daily Disciples
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-may-20-11575813.html
Passage: Exodus 28:29
Points:
- Families wear picture badges of missing loved ones to keep them close to their hearts and visible to others.
- Aaron wore the names of the twelve tribes engraved on gemstones over his heart as an ongoing memorial before God.
- Believers are considered precious jewels, continually carried over the heart of Jesus, our High Priest.
- Even when believers wander or drift away, Christ continually presents them before the Father.
- Christians can rest in the assurance of being deeply valued and are urged to hold Christ closely in devotion and worship.
